name: task
description: Run one subagent synchronously and return its final output. Use when one delegated result is needed before continuing; use `task_spawn` for independent concurrent work. Top-level agents only.

description.description: Short description of what this task will do (3-10 words).

prompt.description: Self-contained instructions: goal, scope, relevant context, constraints, and expected output.

agent.description: Optional subagent name (default: auto-select). Omit unless you know the exact name.

model.description: Optional model override. Default: reuse parent model; override only when the subtask is clearly lighter or heavier.

inherit.description: Omit for the default: 'cwd,skills' (history/memory private), which is right for workspace-touching steps; serial steps hand off via files. Pass a plain string otherwise: 'all', 'none', or a comma-separated subset of 'history', 'memory', 'cwd', 'skills' (e.g. "cwd,skills"); 'none' for pure analysis; 'all' only when the subtask needs the full conversation.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object the subagent's single returned value must match, e.g. {"type": "string"} — not a bare type name.
